name: check_linked_record_chain

name: unload_unused_font_entries

name: release_font_when_unused

name: copy_name_until_terminator

name: read_font_file_bytes

name: scan_font_directory_entries

name: return_zero_stub

name: score_glyph_bit_differences

name: subtract_glyph_bit_weights
description: Continues the bit-plane comparison between two glyph records, subtracting a weight from the running score for each mismatched bit.

name: accumulate_glyph_plane_weights

name: accumulate_glyph_plane_weights

name: free_sized_block_before_pointer

description: Returns a pointer to the last occurrence of a given character in a string of known length, scanning backward from the end, or null when it is absent.

name: find_last_character_in_string
description: Scans backward from the end of a string for a given character, stopping at a lower bound, and returns the matching position or null.

name: find_last_character_in_string
description: Scans backward from a position for a given character, returning null when the lower bound is passed.

name: skip_path_to_filename
description: Returns a pointer just past the first slash in a path or, if there is none, past the first colon. It returns the original pointer when neither character is present.

name: increment_returned_value
description: Returns its register input incremented by one.

name: forward_call_no_result
description: Calls one further routine with no arguments and no result, then returns. It only relays the call and performs no work of its own.

name: forward_call_no_result
description: Calls one further routine with no arguments and no result, then returns. It only relays the call and performs no work of its own.

name: forward_call_no_result
description: Calls one further routine with no arguments and no result, then returns. It only relays the call and performs no work of its own.

name: forward_call_no_result
description: Calls one further routine with no arguments and no result, then returns. It only relays the call and performs no work of its own.

name: start_program_with_task_check
description: Program entry that finds the running task and checks a field of it. When that field is clear it performs a setup step, then runs the main body and calls a finishing routine if the setup flag was set, using exec task, message and port routines.

name: read_write_scores_file
description: Opens the s:defender_scores file through the dos library and reads or writes its contents, XORing each stored 32-bit word with a constant key.

name: update_audio_volumes_by_state
description: When a state value equals one, clears a table of entries, computes a scaled value from a 16-bit field and writes it to the audio channel volume registers, then resets counters. It then runs loops over stored values and calls helper routines.

name: accumulate_nibble_table_into_globals
description: Walks a table of bytes in groups of four, accumulating the high and low nibbles of each byte into two global counters and calling a helper whenever a counter is nonzero.

name: draw_glyph_indexes_to_bitplane
description: Reads 16-bit glyph index entries from a global table until a sentinel value, and for each entry writes eight bytes of glyph data into a bitplane buffer.

name: update_audio_channel_records
description: Updates audio channel records for four channels from stored state values, returning early when a playback flag is set and its mode equals three.

name: select_nonzero_channel_entry
description: Walks a table of four 16-bit entries from the top down, storing each nonzero entry into a global variable. It appears to be decoded from a gap in the code and is not reached through a normal call path.

name: decrement_countdown_update_position
description: Decrements a countdown global and, when it reaches zero, updates a position value from a stored table and writes a combined result to another global.

name: blit_descriptor_list_entries
description: Walks a global table of descriptors until a sentinel value, and for each entry waits for the blitter to become idle before programming its source and destination registers.

name: configure_blitter_copy_block
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then writes control words and pointers into a blitter control block to configure a scanline copy.

name: update_active_entry_positions
description: Walks a global list of entries until a sentinel value, skipping inactive ones, and for each active entry with a type code from one to thirteen computes a screen position from its stored coordinates.

name: set_scroll_mask_from_position
description: Computes a scroll mask from the low bits of a position global and stores it in another global. When a flag is clear it also programs the blitter with fixed masks and a row count.

name: update_table_entries_by_flag
description: Walks a table of 16-bit entries and, for each empty entry, checks a global flag bit. When the bit is set it clears it and computes a screen position from two global coordinates.

name: update_horizontal_position_from_flags
description: Adjusts a horizontal position global by two steps when flag bits are set, clamping at a fixed limit, and calls two helper routines when a counter is below one.

name: decode_control_word_flags
description: Reads a 16-bit word from a structure at a fixed offset and sets a mode value and flags in globals according to its low bits and bits eight and nine.

name: combine_key_bits_into_control
description: Tests several bytes of a keypress table and ORs a bit into a control word for each byte that is set, then updates a control byte from another table entry.

name: update_entry_counter_flags
description: Increments a counter in a per-entry table selected by an index. When the counter reaches fifty it updates flags and calls a helper routine.

name: draw_masked_rows_to_bitplanes
description: Iterates over a small set of rows, computing a screen offset for each, and writes masked bits from a source table into the bitplane buffers.

name: compute_wrapped_position_difference
description: Computes a wrapped horizontal difference between two position globals, adjusting it by 2048 when it falls outside a range, then scans a table until a sentinel value.

name: blit_counter_block_below_six
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then when a counter is below six programs blitter registers for a fixed block and copies data from a source table.

name: blit_second_block_below_six
description: Returns early when a second counter exceeds five. Otherwise it waits for the blitter and programs its registers to copy a block from a source table.

name: blit_counter_block_in_range
description: When a counter lies between one and five, waits for the blitter, programs its control and mask registers, and copies a block from a source table.

name: blit_second_block_in_range
description: When a second counter lies between one and five, programs the blitter control registers and copies a block from a source table.

name: call_helpers_by_value_threshold
description: Calls helper routines according to how large a stored 32-bit value is, testing it against thresholds of 255, 65535 and 16777215.

name: draw_two_digit_pair_glyphs
description: Splits a byte into its two nibbles, maps a zero nibble to the value ten, and copies glyph data for each resulting digit into a bitplane buffer eight times.

name: dispatch_interrupt_request_handlers
description: Reads the interrupt enable and request registers together and calls a handler for each of two request bits that are set.
